text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
――Then, our presentation topic for social 
studies will be "The History and Evolution 
of the Tiara Route"!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The lottery results are in, and the ones 
in charge of the presentation materials 
are ...Pandora-chan and Yukino-chan! We're 
counting on you two!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yikes... A-A presentation, huh...? I've 
gotta give it my all so I don't drag 
everyone down...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? Don't worry, don't worry! You've got 
genius Pandora-chan by your side~ Piece of 
cake♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this photo would be good... But 
that's a finish line photo, so... 
definitely this one?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The photos go here... Ah! I'll add a cute 
frame♡

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You can even do things like that...! I'm 
learnin' so much~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo tiiired~~~! Hey, hey, let's take 
a break~♡

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Just a little longer for me! ...I've 
gotta make up for lost time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Really~? Alrighty, see you later then!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: All right, all done~☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gyah!? You're done already!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totes☆ Look, look! Doesn't this feel 
suuper good? ♡

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Woooow, that's mighty gorgeous. 
Pandora-chan, ya look like a pro.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah~♡ Though I just tweaked a 
template and copy-pasted some random 
materials into it♡

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Tem-pura...? Co-py...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So, how much do you have left, 
Yukino-chan? Wanna hand from me~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! That won't do at all! I'll take 
care of my own share, so don't you worry!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! I'll put my own twist on this 
tempura and finish it with that... 
whatcha-call-it... compi-something!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Let's practice the presentation for 
tomorrow! ...Pandora-chan, can you project 
the slides?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty! Now then, where did the 
finalized data go...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Something about this data... 
seems weird.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so, so sorry...! It's all because I 
messed up saving it... What am I gonna 
do...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It's an ill wind, isn't it? Still, if we 
all work together—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah. It'll be a breeze if you help 
out♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
B-But...! I've caused you so much trouble 
already, I can't ask for any more—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? Who cares, it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not like you did it on purpose~. Both 
Yukino-chan and I worked super hard~. And 
above all――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"We're cute, after all♡ So it'll be 
totally fine, totally fine♪"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fue!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaand that's the story. Pwease hewp 
me, evewyone♡

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe! Ahahaha! ...Pandora-chan, you 
really are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Right. No time to be moping around. ...If 
I messed up, I just gotta bounce back from 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please, from me too! I know I'm 
always causing trouble, but... Would you 
mind lending us a hand?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Pretty please, pretty please~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...and after all that, we're having an 
afterparty right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Pandora whipped through the documents 
with an incredible, whooshing burst of 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, it was amazing even from the prep work 
beforehand! No panicking, super fast, and 
totally efficient!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The MVP this time is without a doubt 
Pandora-chan!
choice_data_list: You really worked hard, huh, Pandora.
You can make presentation materials too?!
You can make presentation materials too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The MVP this time is without a doubt 
Pandora-chan!
choice_data_list: You really worked hard, huh, Pandora.
You can make presentation materials too?!
You can make presentation materials too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And her presentation materials were super 
cute too! The teacher absolutely loved 
them♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe... For real? Well, I'm a genius, 
so of course I did!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Well then. I worked hard, so give me a 
reward, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, well, yeah~♪ Surprised by my sheer 
genius?
choice_data_list:
Yeah... Maybe I'll ask for some help 
making it next time.

Yeah... Maybe I'll have you help me make 
it next time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehh, no way! Do your own work yourself!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Pandora-san really is like a 
sweeping wind, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She's always so bright and 
positive... She's truly indispensable to 
our class♪
